newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sentrachem yr shr rises, div up.
newsitem.headline: Sentrachem yr shr rises, div up.

text.p: NOTE - Analysts polled by Reuters forecast earnings rising to between 125 and 130 cents a share with a consensus 130.5 cents. They expected a dividend of 37 cents, compared to 35 cents.
Directors said the exceptional items consisted of profits made on the sale of businesses, less the cost of business closures and retrenchment costs.

Managing director John Job said he expected Sentrachem to see real growth in the 1996/97 financial year based on a solid platform on which to consolidate and develop new initiatives and despite an uncertain local economic climate.

He said the company was close to achieving its target of obtaining 50 percent of its sales revenue from locally-made, locally sold products, 25 percent from locally-made exports and 25 percent from its offshore sources.
